g.text: Marks beside the names: evidence class of the UAA status. mtRF1a sequences in the [E] block and in the tylenchids are exploratory.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Orange cell: S at human 216 (T216S). Green cell: T at 216. Blue cell: residue other than Q at 203. Human numbering NP_061914.3. Radopholus +2 aa (placement approximate).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Loop length against tylenchid Stop sisters (PREREG 2.4): Rotylenchulus 27 aa against 26 in R. robustus, P. vulnus and M. hapla (+1 aa); +0 against human.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Partial sequences (Cephalodiscus, Radopholus): gaps are missing data. The two P. vulnus models with +14 aa read through a 47-nt intron and are not used (REPORT 6). H. columbus is omitted (bacterial).

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: [E] exploratory block: Albula, Lycenchelys, Craniella (non-U33 Stop) and three sisters. Rotylenchulus is an unconfirmed single-genome candidate (stem-blocked). T191S is not isolable in Anomia/Placuna (GATE_0).
